basic_info.description:
This lovely, 2bd/2bth UNFURNISHED, 1500 sf modern condo is located in the heart of Pacific Heights, walking distance to shops, restaurants and city and tech bus stops on Union, Van Ness, Polk and Fillmore Streets. All your needs are taken care of in this well-cared for, luxury condo building including 1 car SUV parking included , private storage unit included, laundry and PAID utilities: Cable, heat, water and garbage. Tenants pay electric and cable upgrades only. There is a large open living room with direct access to a large private deck with park and city views. The kitchen is adjacent with room for a breakfast table and featuring granite counters, newer appliances and plenty of cabinetry. There is a large master bedroom with great views including lots of closet space and a master bathroom suite. The second bedroom is also good sized with a HUGE walk-in closet. A second hall bathroom features shower over tub. There is also a lovely shared roof deck with amazing city and bay views! Available for a lease start date between now and Sept. 1, 2019. Move in must be coordinate with the HOA and there are fees. MUST have excellent credit, income and references!

Owner pays for water and refuse service.
